Crown is the president. Crown is also the commander of the presidency. 
The climate is on Lion, so 'If the Crown's Army strength is 3+ they will attempt to purchase the cheapest affordable Local Alliance...'
My question is what happens if the Crown's army strength is not 3+?  Do they not purchase any Local Alliances?
Thanks in advance
